# Alarm (fixture): lines 3 and 4 count

- 🔴 Reply in the room first.
- ⛔ Sending money without a yes.
- Status as a checklist: ☑ done, ☐ not yet, ⛔ blocked, since it reads at a glance.
- State marks: 🟢 done, 🟠 running, 🔴 failed, so the colour comes first.
- Quote the card line `🔴 not sent` when a send fails.
